verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the mailbox handles shipments and returns, and that packages can be shipped to any address with savings when bundled, which covers forwarding and consolidation (docs-24, docs-26, docs-34). There is no evidence that the address accepts packages from all major carriers, or that packages can be held or picked up locally. missing for 10: acceptance of all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS), hold-for-pickup option, package storage/hold terms, independent or hands-on corroboration.
